Directional Thesis

Point price prediction over mutual fund horizons fails due to low signal-to-noise, non-stationary macro regimes, and lack of regulatory auditability. With Indian MF AUM > Rs 70 lakh crore and monthly SIP inflows > Rs 26,000 crore, DIIs are the dominant structural marginal buyer alongside tactical FPI flows. Our engine outputs calibrated posterior probabilities across 5 Indian regimes (Risk-Off, Post-Shock, Transitional, Late-Cycle, Risk-On) with split-conformal & online ACI uncertainty sets.
